messages:
Alex Li: FYI ACME POC keeps throwing 401s right after token refresh. Happens ~5-10m after obtaining a new token. Logs show 'missing Authorization header' and occasionally 'token expired'. cc @Maya @Samir
Maya Chen: can you paste the request that failed? Is this during refresh flow or normal call? @Jordan can you check proxy logs?
Alex Li: here's the curl we used from their test harness:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  https://api.redwood.prod/v1/chat/complete -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/2 401
date: Tue, 21 Mar 2025 15:12:40 GMT
content-type: application/json
{
  'error': 'missing Authorization header'
}
```
Samir Patel: interesting — we've seen this with an internal envoy config that strips Authorization when forwarding to upstream if there's proxy auth. Jordan (oncall) can you grep for 'remove_headers' or any remove_request_headers rules?
Jordan (oncall): checking... found a route with remove_request_headers that included Authorization in the stage env. Looks like a legacy snippet from when we proxied behind corp-sso. I'll re-deploy a test patch to remove that rule in the staging proxy.
Alex Li: also noticed tokens show expiry at '2025-03-21T11:12:40-04:00' in the assertion but our server validates in UTC. If the client is issuing tokens with local TZ and not normalizing, they might appear expired. Could be two issues.
Maya Chen: good catch. Two simultaneous causes = intermittent 401s. Jordan, can you confirm proxy fix + we ask ACME to ensure their token generator uses UTC timestamps (or to send expiry as unix epoch)?
Jordan (oncall): proxy patch applied in staging; will roll to prod in 10m if no regression. Also set a short-term workaround: accept Authorization from X-Forwarded-Authorization header added by proxy to avoid header strip.
Samir Patel: noted — I'll add a note to the presales runbook: when customer is behind proxies, check for header stripping and TZ/clock skew. Temporary mitigation: set system clock via NTP and add header passthrough configs.
presales-bot: Reminder: POC checklist updated — ask customer for environment details (proxy, NAT, time sync) before next test. :white_check_mark:
Alex Li: ACME confirmed they were running a test harness in a container with the timezone set to 'America/New_York' and their token creation lib incorrectly formatted expiry. They're fixing. Can we keep the prod patch?
Jordan (oncall): prod patch rolled. Monitoring shows no Authorization errors in the last 15m. I'll leave the passthrough rule for 24h then remove after we confirm.
Maya Chen: great, can someone add a short KB entry? 'Intermittent 401s during POCs: proxy header stripping + token TZ mismatch'. Keep it short.
Alex Li: will write KB and link it in the POC ticket. Thanks all :pray:
